- Deselect one test case for the timeout issue in v1/shutdown https://buildkite.com/vllm/intel-ci/builds/16237/list?jid=01a19b25-b61e-4219-a746-3e554b7a5e3b&tab=output, An internal issue has been filed to track this.

## Validation

|---|---|---|---|

--deselect="tests/v1/shutdown/test_forward_error.py::test_llm_model_error[hmellor/tiny-random-LlamaForCausalLM-2-True]"
```

Could you explain why it's being skipped (failure link or tracking issue), add that to the description, or move it to its own PR? Happy to approve once that's clarified.
